image.label: A: Smooth spiral
image.summary: A smooth, tightly twisted spiral like a narwhal tusk, pearl white with a soft sheen. Look at the clean, even twist.
image.prompt: Character design study for an original creature called a Hypnopet: a small golden-furred bunny with very long lop ears hanging almost to the ground, very large eyes, a large round head, big hind feet with toe pads, a paler face mask and chest, and a single spiral unicorn horn rising from a tuft of fur on the crown. The attached silhouette.png is the creator's silhouette: use it only for overall proportions and features, not for style or pose. Clean modern cartoon character style with soft shading. No text, no labels, no watermark. Close-up of the creature's head from a three-quarter view, focused on the horn: a smooth, tightly twisted spiral like a narwhal tusk, pearl white, rising from a tuft of crown fur. Plain light gray background.
